description:
Disable Full Build Pipeline to improve CI/CD performance.

# Rationale

The full build pipeline is one of the first actions to start and the last to finish.  Therefore, it reduces the number of threads available to other actions.  In recent memory, its failures have consistently been redundant to other actions' failures.  All required evaluations are made in other actions.  Therefore, it can be inactivated until a case is identified where it is needed.

reviews.body: ## Pull request overview This PR removes the full-build-pipeline GitHub Actions workflow to improve CI/CD performance by freeing up runner threads. The rationale states that the pipeline's checks are redundant with other workflows, and its failures have consistently aligned with other actions' failures. **Changes:** - Completely deletes the `full-build-pipeline.yml` workflow file that validated the complete build pipeline from setup through production Docker image creation --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews.
